reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Lost Mitten Office 003
materials.text: At the lost-and-found desk, a child asks about a mitten. Choose the reply that fits each short talk.

questions.prompt: Child: Excuse me. Helper: ____
questions.explanation: A回应打扰并提供帮助；B晚安、C喜好均不合场景。

questions.prompt: Helper: Is this your mitten? Child: ____
questions.explanation: B确认物品归属；A星期、C心情不回答Is this。

questions.prompt: Helper: What colour is your other mitten? Child: ____
questions.explanation: C答颜色；A位置、B动物不答What colour。

questions.prompt: Child: Thank you for your help. Helper: ____
questions.explanation: A回应感谢；B能力、C物品名称均不合。

questions.prompt: Helper: Please write your name here. Child: ____
questions.explanation: B接受写名指令；A天气、C人物关系不能回应要求。

materials.title: Birthday Card Talk 003
materials.text: Friends give a birthday card to Kim. Choose a suitable reply in each small talk.

questions.prompt: Friend: Happy birthday, Kim! Kim: ____
questions.explanation: A接受生日祝福并感谢；B告别不合；C自称铅笔不合理。

questions.prompt: Kim: What is in the box? Friend: ____
questions.explanation: B回答盒中物品；A天气、C状态未答What。

questions.prompt: Friend: How old are you today? Kim: ____
questions.explanation: C答年龄；A地点、B喜好不答How old。

questions.prompt: Kim: Let us sing a song. Friend: ____
questions.explanation: A赞同唱歌建议；B物品、C身高均不回应建议。

questions.prompt: Friend: This card is for you. Kim: ____
questions.explanation: B感谢并称赞卡片；A关门指令、C找鞋均与收到卡片无关。

materials.title: Vowel Pet Room 003
materials.text:
Choose from the shared word bank. Match the vowel sound in the word in capitals and complete each sentence. Use each word once. Bank: A. cake B. bike C. nose D. cube E. five
1. Kate (KATE) puts a birthday ____1____ on the plate.
2. Mike (MIKE) can ride his ____2____ to the park.
3. Rose (ROSE) draws a face with a small ____3____.
4. A cute (CUTE) block with six square faces is a ____4____.
5. I like (LIKE) the number after four. It is ____5____.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A cake与KATE均/eɪ/且生日蛋糕合义；B bike、E five为/aɪ/；C nose为/əʊ/；D cube为/juː/，均不合目标音与句义。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B bike与MIKE均/aɪ/且可骑；A cake /eɪ/、C nose /əʊ/、D cube /juː/不同音；E five同音但数字不能被ride。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C nose与ROSE均/əʊ/且是脸部；A cake /eɪ/、B bike和E five /aɪ/、D cube /juː/均不合读音与脸部语义。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: D cube与CUTE均含/juː/，六面正方形物块是立方体；A cake /eɪ/、B bike和E five /aɪ/、C nose /əʊ/，均不合读音和物块定义。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E five与LIKE均/aɪ/且四之后是五；B bike虽同音不是数字；A cake /eɪ/、C nose /əʊ/、D cube /juː/不合。

materials.title: Duck Pond Rules 003
materials.text: There is a pond in our park. Six ducks live there. A sign says, "Do not give bread to the ducks." I have some bread in my bag, but I keep it there. A park worker gives the ducks their food. I sit on a bench with Grandma. We watch a little duck follow its mother. We do not go into the water.

questions.prompt: Six ducks live in the pond.
questions.explanation: A正确：six ducks直接给数量；B与明确数量事实相反。

questions.prompt: The sign asks people to give bread to the ducks.
questions.explanation: B正确：标牌Do not give bread；A漏读否定。

questions.prompt: The writer keeps the bread in the bag.
questions.explanation: A正确：I keep it there指留包里；B否认作者行为。

questions.prompt: Grandma sits in the water.
questions.explanation: B正确：与作者坐bench上；A把长椅改成水中。

questions.prompt: A little duck follows its mother.
questions.explanation: A正确：末段给出跟随动作；B与观察内容不符。

units.title: 班级花园里的工具词库

materials.title: Garden Water Bank 003
materials.text:
Read the whole passage and choose a word from the bank for each gap. Use each word once. Bank: A. empty B. gloves C. under D. water E. Friday
Our class works in the garden every ____1____, the day after Thursday. We wear ____2____ to keep our hands clean. The soil is dry, so we ____3____ the young plants. Then we put the tools ____4____ the bench, not on top of it. The watering can has no water left. It is ____5____.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: E Friday是周四后一天；A空的、B手套、C下面、D浇水均不是星期名。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B gloves可穿戴保护手；A形容空、C介词、D水或浇水、E星期均不是手部用品。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: D water作动词浇植物；A空的、B手套、C下面、E星期不能构成所需动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C under与not on top构成位置对比；A形容词、B物品、D水或浇水、E星期均不接the bench表达所需位置。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A empty与没有剩水对应；B手套、C下面、D水、E星期不描述壶空了。

units.title: 博物馆寄存外套的小票

materials.title: Museum Coat Ticket 003
materials.text: At the town museum, children leave their wet coats at a desk. The worker gives each child a numbered ticket. The same number is on the coat hook. "Keep the ticket," she says. "You need it to get your coat back." Dan puts his ticket in his shoe because his trousers have no pockets. After the visit, he forgets where it is. His friend asks him to think about the morning. Dan remembers and finds the ticket. The worker checks it and gives him the right coat.

questions.prompt: Why do the children leave their coats?
questions.explanation: A首句wet coats；B无出售计划；C无尺寸问题。

questions.prompt: What matches the number on a ticket?
questions.explanation: B同编号在衣钩上；A公交、C饭盒未涉及。

questions.prompt: Where does Dan put his ticket?
questions.explanation: C原文放鞋内；A裤子无口袋且没说放外套；B未提书下。

questions.prompt: How does Dan find the ticket?
options: He thinks about what he did earlier.
questions.explanation: A朋友让回想早上，他记起位置；B没买新票；C没拿朋友票。

questions.prompt: What does the worker do before giving back the coat?
questions.explanation: B核对票后还衣；A刷钩、C找老师均未发生。

units.title: 做鸟巢箱前的五个问题

materials.title: Bird Box Builder Talk 003
materials.text: A pupil asks the workshop leader about making a bird box. Match each question with the best answer. Bank: A. Soft wood, because it is easy to cut. B. On the high wall near the trees. C. To keep the rain outside. D. Next Saturday morning. E. An adult will help us with the sharp tools.

questions.prompt: What material will we use for the box?
options: Soft wood, because it is easy to cut.
On the high wall near the trees.
An adult will help us with the sharp tools.
questions.explanation: A回答材料木头；B位置、C目的、D时间、E工具协助者均不答材料。

questions.prompt: Where will we put the finished box?
options: Soft wood, because it is easy to cut.
On the high wall near the trees.
An adult will help us with the sharp tools.
questions.explanation: B回答安装位置；A材料、C目的、D时间、E成人帮助不答Where。

questions.prompt: Why does the box need a roof?
options: Soft wood, because it is easy to cut.
On the high wall near the trees.
An adult will help us with the sharp tools.
questions.explanation: C说明屋顶挡雨目的；A选材理由不答屋顶用途；B位置、D时间、E协助均不合。

questions.prompt: When will the workshop begin?
options: Soft wood, because it is easy to cut.
On the high wall near the trees.
An adult will help us with the sharp tools.
questions.explanation: D回答开课时间；A材料、B地点、C目的、E协助不答When。

questions.prompt: Who will help us use the sharp tools?
options: Soft wood, because it is easy to cut.
On the high wall near the trees.
An adult will help us with the sharp tools.
questions.explanation: E明确成人协助尖锐工具；A材料、B地点、C目的、D时间都未答Who。

materials.title: Piano Practice Message 003
materials.text:
Message for Tuesday’s piano club:
The music room floor is wet after a pipe broke. Today’s club will meet in Room 12 beside the art room. The piano cannot be moved, so we will practise rhythm with small drums instead. Bring your music book, but leave your piano folder at home. The club still starts at four o’clock and finishes at four forty. Please wait inside Room 12 for the teacher. Do not wait by the music room door. Parents should collect children from the side gate because workers are using the main entrance. Next week’s room will be confirmed on Monday.
Ms Ford

questions.prompt: Why is the club moving rooms today?
options: The art room needs a piano.
A broken pipe has made the music room floor wet.
The music room is too small.
questions.explanation: B管道破裂地面湿；A没说美术室需钢琴；C非空间问题；D家长无此要求。

questions.prompt: What will children practise today?
questions.explanation: C原文改小鼓练节奏；A刷墙、B户外唱歌无据；D明确钢琴不能挪。

questions.prompt: What should children bring?
questions.explanation: A带music book；B要求留家；C修理管道不是学生准备；D没有要求自带整套鼓。

questions.prompt: Where should parents collect children?
questions.explanation: D家长侧门接；B大门工人使用；A窗边、C美术商店均未提。

questions.prompt: What does the message say about next week?
options: The club will definitely be in Room 12.
The room will be confirmed on Monday.
The club will end at five.
questions.explanation: B下周教室周一确认；A把今天安排当永久；C时间仍4:40；D未要求修钢琴。

units.title: 自行车服务站的礼貌表达

materials.title: Asking At Cycle Centre 003
materials.text: At a cycle centre, choose the sentence that best achieves the speaker’s purpose in each situation.

questions.prompt: You want a staff member to show you how to lower the seat. What should you ask?
options: Could you show me how to lower the seat?
How much is the red helmet?
questions.explanation: A请求示范调低车座；B问头盔价、C问昨天来程，均不实现操作求助。

questions.prompt: You did not hear the safety rule clearly. What should you say?
options: I have never owned this bicycle.
Could you say that rule again, please?
questions.explanation: B礼貌请求重说规则；A说拥有经历、C陈述比赛时间，均不澄清听漏内容。

questions.prompt: A smaller child cannot reach the water tap. You offer help. What should you say?
options: Why did you buy a tap?
Would you like me to turn it on for you?
questions.explanation: C主动提出帮开水龙头；A购买原因、B地址无关。

questions.prompt: You need permission to leave your bicycle by the desk for ten minutes. What should you ask?
options: May I leave my bicycle here for ten minutes?
Is this desk made of wood?
Can you ride faster than me?
questions.explanation: A明确请求临停许可及时间；B材质、C速度比较不答需求。

questions.prompt: You return a borrowed pump and want to thank the worker. What should you say?
options: The pump was invented long ago.
Thank you for lending me the pump.
Please buy me a new bicycle.
questions.explanation: B感谢借泵；A历史信息、C买新车要求不表达归还感谢。

units.title: 晚间阅读活动的信号约定

materials.title: Library Night Signals 003
materials.text:
For the library’s evening reading event, teams had to move between three rooms. The organisers first planned to ring a bell whenever it was time to change rooms. During a trial, they found that the bell disturbed a quiet reading session next door. They also realised that a sound alone would not help every visitor.

The team replaced the bell with a simple system. A helper in each room held up a yellow card two minutes before a change. A green card meant the next room was ready. Visitors who wanted a spoken reminder could ask the helper. The cards did not tell people which room to visit; a printed route on each team’s sheet did that.

On the evening itself, one green card went up too early while chairs were still being moved. The helper lowered it immediately and explained the mistake. Nobody was asked to walk through the crowded doorway. In the review, organisers added a rule: check with the next room’s helper before showing green. They kept the yellow warning because it gave readers time to finish a page.

questions.prompt: Why was the bell plan changed?
options: The library had sold every bell.
It disturbed another session and was not useful to every visitor.
The teams had no route sheets.
questions.explanation: B两项明确原因：打扰和单靠声音不足；A没卖铃；C无音乐请求；D已有路线单。

questions.prompt: What did a yellow card mean?
options: A room change was coming in two minutes.
Visitors had arrived at the wrong building.
questions.explanation: C黄卡提前两分钟提示；A取消、B拥堵、D错楼不是规定含义。

questions.prompt: How did visitors know which room to visit next?
options: From the colour of their coats.
questions.explanation: A路线单确定房间；B衣色无关；C铃已替换；D无任意选择规则。

questions.prompt: What happened when a green card was shown too soon?
options: Visitors were made to push through.
The helper withdrew it and explained.
questions.explanation: D立刻放下并解释；A明确没要求穿拥堵门；B未结束；C没有忽略。

questions.prompt: What new check was added?
options: Confirm readiness with the next room’s helper before green.
questions.explanation: B复盘增加跨房确认；A非规则；C没让带铃；D仍允许口头提醒。
